submission_results.hypothesis: Observation: the attribute key '"' is sanitized by replaceAll("[^-a-zA-Z0-9_:.]", "") to an empty string, and setAttribute("") throws INVALID_CHARACTER_ERR in the W3C DOM. Causal explanation: copyAttributes does not check that the sanitized key is a valid XML attribute name. Fix: only call setAttribute when the sanitized key matches the XML name pattern [a-zA-Z_:][-a-zA-Z0-9_:.]*, so invalid names are skipped instead of throwing. Refutation: if handlesInvalidAttributeNames still throws from setAttribute, the invalid key is not empty or the pattern check is bypassed.
